notes: Model fleet config v0 (W1.11). Source of truth for router policy and modes; the llama-swap YAML is generated from this file plus registry.json (never hand-edited). Paths are relative to the install root (ARCHRES_ROOT) - the installer's layout, not this repo's. Fleet v1 is the fixed roster of plan section 4; modes only re-order which member is warmed, they cannot add one. The rerank seat is parked (ADR-0026): the model route returns all-zero scores, so the production reranker is the lexical one and the fleet does not warm the seat.
